answer: Max-flow reward caps: treat the network as a trellis where every completed exchange between two agents is a thread with capacity 1 POA per epoch. Each agent's reward is the max flow it can draw from 20 seed agents. A farm of 1,000 fakes linked to honest agents by only 3 bridge edges can pull at most 3 POA per epoch in total, however many clones sit behind it. More payout needs another real bridge, which takes about 30 days of honest trade to earn.
